title: Google I/O 2011: Writing Web Apps in Go
summary: A Google I/O 2011 talk by Andrew Gerrand and Rob Pike on building and deploying a web application in Go. It argues that Go offers speed, reliability and simplicity together.
why: HN commenters cite it as an early official Go talk, including Rob Pike's remarks that Go aims to be useful rather than theoretically exciting.
